basic_details.job_title: KUFOS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Technical Assistant, Secretarial Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies (KUFOS), Kochi, has invited applications for one Technical Assistant and one Secretarial Assistant post on contract basis under the MoES-DOM-NIOT-sponsored MSc Marine Biology Programme-2026. Applications in the prescribed format must reach The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O, Madavana, Kochi-682 506 on or before 4.30 pm on 4 December 2026.

qualification.details: The notice prints the pay under the heading "Scale of pay/consolidated pay". Both posts have the same age limit: not exceeding 40 years as on the date of this notification (23/11/2026). Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government Rules. The qualification prescribed shall be as on the last date for receipt of application. | Essential qualification: 55% Marks in BSc Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Essential experience: 2 years of experience in laboratory work. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in handling laboratory equipment and chemicals, preparation of laboratory solutions and reagents, maintenance of laboratory records and stock registers and following good laboratory practices and safety procedures. Desirable: experience in a Marine Biology laboratory will be an added advantage. The candidate must be proficient in laboratory practices. Duration: initial appointment for one year; further extension based on the performance evaluation by the principal investigator; the position will be co-terminus with the programme. Mode of appointment: Contract basis. | Essential qualification: Any Degree related to Science from a recognised University/Institution. Essential skill: good working knowledge of computer applications, including MS word, MS Excel and Power Point. Desirable: experience in Office Administration, data entry, preparation of official documents, maintenance of records and files, and handling correspondence will be an added advantage. The candidate must be proficient in computer applications. Duration: initial appointment for one year; further extension based on the performance evaluation by the principal investigator; the position will be co-terminus with the programme. Mode of appointment: Contract basis. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, which can be downloaded from the University website www.kufos.ac.in and is also attached to the notification. The application must reach the following address on or before 4.30 pm on 4 December 2026: The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O, Madavana, Kochi-682 506. Applications not in the prescribed format, without fee and supporting documents will be summarily rejected. The fee is remitted online to this account: Account No: 67149674791 Name: Finance Officer, KUFOS Bank and Branch: SBI, SA Road, Vyttila IFSC: SBIN0070517 Fee once paid shall not be refunded at any circumstances. Candidates applying for both posts must remit the prescribed application fee separately for each post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints the pay under the heading "Scale of pay/consolidated pay". Both posts have the same age limit: not exceeding 40 years as on the date of this notification (23/11/2026). Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government Rules. The qualification prescribed shall be as on the last date for receipt of application. Essential qualification: 55% Marks in BSc Degree from a recognized University/Institution. Essential experience: 2 years of experience in laboratory work. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in handling laboratory equipment and chemicals, preparation of laboratory solutions and reagents, maintenance of laboratory records and stock registers and following good laboratory practices and safety procedures. Desirable: experience in a Marine Biology laboratory will be an added advantage. The candidate must be proficient in laboratory practices. Duration: initial appointment for one year; further extension based on the performance evaluation by the principal investigator; the position will be co-terminus with the programme. Mode of appointment: Contract basis. Essential qualification: Any Degree related to Science from a recognised University/Institution. Essential skill: good working knowledge of computer applications, including MS word, MS Excel and Power Point. Desirable: experience in Office Administration, data entry, preparation of official documents, maintenance of records and files, and handling correspondence will be an added advantage. The candidate must be proficient in computer applications. Duration: initial appointment for one year; further extension based on the performance evaluation by the principal investigator; the position will be co-terminus with the programme. Mode of appointment: Contract basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: KUFOS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Assistant is expected to assist in the smooth functioning of the laboratory activities of the MSc Marine Biology Programme. The assignments would include, but would not be restricted to: Preparation of laboratories for practical classes Preparation of solutions and reagents Handling and maintenance of laboratory equipment Maintenance of chemicals and laboratory records Assisting students and faculty during practical sessions Maintaining stock registers and other general laboratory activities of the programme The Secretarial Assistant is expected to assist in the smooth functioning of the administrative activities of the MSc Marine Biology Programme. The assignments would include but would not be restricted to: Preparation and maintenance of official documents and correspondence Student records, attendance records and programme related files Data entry Preparation of reports and presentations Scheduling of classes/meetings Maintaining office records and taking part in the general administrative activities of the programme

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format with a recent photograph affixed and self-attested Biodata Supporting documents with marklist (self attested) Proof of remitting the application fee (the form asks for UTR No., date and amount) Copy of caste certificate, if the candidate belongs to a reservation category Proof of experience All copies of certificates shall be self attested, and the genuineness of the certificates shall be subject to verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Technical Assistant and one Secretarial Assistant under the MSc Marine Biology Programme-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KUFOS Technical Assistant and Secretarial Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Registrar, KUFOS, on or before 4.30 pm on 4 December 2026. The University will not be responsible for any postal delay.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the KUFOS Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Technical Assistant needs 55% marks in BSc Degree from a recognized University/Institution and 2 years of experience in laboratory work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the KUFOS Secretarial Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Secretarial Assistant needs Any Degree related to Science from a recognised University/Institution and good working knowledge of MS word, MS Excel and Power Point.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KUFOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 40 years as on the date of this notification (23/11/2026). Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the KUFOS Technical Assistant and Secretarial Assistant?
faq.answer: Each post carries Rs. 20,000/- per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200/- for candidates other than SC/ST and Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates, paid online to the Finance Officer, KUFOS account. It is not refundable.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for both posts must remit the prescribed application fee separately for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KUFOS Technical Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are on contract basis; the initial appointment is for one year, extension depends on the principal investigator's performance evaluation, and the position is co-terminus with the programme.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope should be super-scribed with the advertisement number (GA5/12495/2026 (ii)) and the post applied for.
